sources.title: GitHub - alperenunlu/ppo-lunarlander-v2: Agent trained with PPO ...
sources.snippet: This is a trained model of a PPO agent playing LunarLander-v2 using the stable-baselines3 library and the RL Zoo. The RL Zoo is a training framework for Stable Baselines3 reinforcement learning agents, with hyperparameter optimization and pre-trained agents included.

sources.title: GitHub - rishisim/LunarLander-v2: Trained model of a PPO agent playing ...
sources.snippet: This is a trained model of a PPO agent playing LunarLander-v2 using the stable-baselines3 library. Using Google Colab, I trained my first Deep Reinforcement Learning agent, a Lunar Lander agent that will learn to land correctly on the moon using Stable-Baselines3.

sources.snippet: What is ppo-LunarLander-v2 ? ppo-LunarLander-v2 is an implementation of the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm applied to the Lunar Lander v2 environment, a classic problem in reinforcement learning (RL).
